core_outcome.statement: The participant-specific action 모임 참여 취소하기 is present with 현재 상태: OPEN on the participant detail, disappears behind the 로그인 필요 gate on reload of the exact detail URL, and returns on the same exact detail URL after visible phone+OTP reauthentication.

findings.observed: Detail at /meetups/ec6f99c1-b0e4-4d41-bb01-1c5044fb95fb showed 현재 상태: OPEN, 인원 현재 2명 · 최소 2명 · 정원 4명, and the participant action 모임 참여 취소하기.
findings.interpretation: The QA-1 participant identity holds an active participation and the screen exposes the matching participant action.

findings.observed: Reloading the exact detail URL replaced the content with a 로그인 필요 gate (heading 로그인하고 모임을 확인해 주세요) and removed OPEN and 모임 참여 취소하기.
findings.interpretation: The session boundary is enforced on reload rather than rendering stale cached detail.

findings.observed: The gate's login anchor carried next=%2Fmeetups%2Fec6f99c1-b0e4-4d41-bb01-1c5044fb95fb; after phone+OTP the app returned to the same detail URL with 현재 상태: OPEN and 모임 참여 취소하기 restored.
findings.interpretation: Return-to-intent works, and the restored participant action is the load-bearing outcome, not merely URL equality.

findings.observed: Tab order reached 뒤로가기, 신고하기, 모임 참여 취소하기 with solid 2px focus outlines, then NEXTJS-PORTAL, 설치, 설치 배너 닫기, 새로고침, BODY.
findings.interpretation: The participant action is keyboard reachable with visible focus; install and new-version banner buttons interleave into the tab order after the primary action.
findings.friction: Keyboard users traverse two promotional banners between the primary action and the end of the page.

findings.observed: elementFromPoint at the center of 모임 참여 취소하기 returned the button itself; ancestors footer.bottom-action-bar z-10 > main > div.route-transition > div.route-gesture-surface--foreground > div.route-stage.
findings.interpretation: No overlay intercepts the participant action on the restored detail in this run, so the Actor's reported intercepted-pointer friction did not reproduce.
findings.friction: none observed here; the route-gesture-surface--foreground layer remains an untested hypothesis, not a verified root cause.

score_notes.error_recovery: 번호 수정 and 인증번호 다시 받기 give recovery paths; invalid-input and expired-OTP paths were not exercised.
score_notes.accessibility_basics: Keyboard reachability and visible focus confirmed; no automated a11y scan and no screen-reader evidence, so this is not proof of screen-reader usability.
score_notes.perceived_friction: Return path itself is frictionless; a second OTP round-trip was required for the same account after reload, and two promotional banners sit in the pre-action tab order.
